edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. It governs your forward steps. - W Seismic Shove spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1, 2s by rank 3 — pre-6 he has no escape at all; after, count the blink. - His Q shield runs on a 9s cooldown: poke twice per shield. - Your W (14s) spent on poke is a death you scheduled; hold R for a fight that matters.

edits.before: His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: His mobility spike — 5s at rank 1 and just 2s at rank 3. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: When he Riftwalks onto you, Seismic Shove throws him back out through your E field — the mine stun turns his engage into your burst window.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: His Nether Blade auto-reset wind-up is the burst tell — at melee range with no W you eat the full rotation uncontested.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP keeps you shoving after every reset; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you roam.
